newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex average prices up 7 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Cemex average prices up 7 pct in January.

text.p: Cemex SA's average realized prices increased by about seven percent in January because of the elimination of discounts near the end of 1996, an executive of the Mexican cement company said on Thursday.

Average realized price for the cement sold by the company to distributors last month rose to almost $81 a tonne from $75 at the end of 1996, said Cemex Planning Director Francisco Cue told Reuters in an interview.
Cemex granted its distributors a 13 to 14 percent discount on list prices in August 1996.
"Demand is picking up, but we have yet to call in all discounts. If there are still some discounts in the market, that's something you cannot call in overnight," Cue said.
